descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · TFA-94422 AC 4; UAT OAT-03 ER 3; TFA-92568 AC 13 · “Mistral calls go through the same Bedrock guardrail as Haiku”. Mixed: stated part — Mistral and Haiku sent with the same guardrail; which AI calls leave without the guardrail (TFA-92568 AC 13); our part — IAM policy denying unguarded invocations, guardrail version pinned rather than DRAFT (only the stated part makes a QA bug).

Bug B26 · S1 · known

The Bedrock guardrail version is not pinned: infra publishes no numbered version and the code defaults to DRAFT (UAT 3.1 asks to record the guardrail version)

Tickets: TFA-94422 ready for qa; TFA-94059 in progress · counts as a QA bug: yes · found on: local (code review)

Approach · OAT-03 Retry/Timeout Resiliency · S23 Mistral goes through the same Bedrock guardrail as Haiku

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U6 The Mistral call goes through the same Bedrock guardrail as Haiku (UAT OAT-03 Expected Result 3; TFA-94422 AC 4)
  • U6b Every AI call (including Ask AI, handoff, photo reading and voice transcription) leaves from the server with the guardrail applied (TFA-92568 AC 13) — gate: blocked: TFA-92568 in progress

Test design technique: Equivalence classes (equivalence) — Check the same rule again with another class of input (Hospital / Nursing Home, other data); every class has to be right.

Given Code at origin/main e02167f; the UAT deployment's guardrail id / version from Tim's 3.1 build record (never read env from )

When Read convex/ai/providers/bedrock.ts (invoke), convex/ai/providers/index.ts (chat, vision), convex/ai/transcribe.ts and infra/stacks/aws.ts (IAM policy); take the guardrail id / version from Tim's 3.1 build record

Then U6: primary and fallback are sent through the same invoke with the same guardrailConfig (id and version); the IAM policy denies any invocation without a guardrail; the guardrail version is pinned (not DRAFT) where UAT runs (ties to OAT-05 step 7). …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Document review with file/line evidence. U6 is judged now (TFA-94422 AC 4). The vision / transcription gap is recorded against U6b, which is gated (TFA-92568 in progress), so it reports as Blocked, not as a Fail of OAT-03 Expected Result 3. A guardrail that masks or blocks returns a normal response and never triggers the fallback (Q7); …

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method CODEREVIEW · Code review; lane planned in the matrix: manual (manual)

S23 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-03.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row.

Issue type: Known product issue · environment local · tickets TFA-92568 in progress; TFA-94422 ready for qa; TFA-94059 in progress

Nothing a physician sees: Haiku and Mistral go through the same Bedrock guardrail, but its version is not pinned, because the infra stack publishes no numbered version and the code falls back to the working DRAFT.

Evidence: allure 0e0bda86-…-result.json; code-review/OAT-03-S23.json. Pins: bedrock.ts:123-124 (the code default is DRAFT), infra/stacks/aws.ts:118/197 (no GuardrailVersion; it exports guardrail.version), .github/workflows/infra.yml:238 (the export is copied into BEDROCK_GUARDRAIL_VERSION). Treated as known because the OAT-05 matrix already notes the DRAFT default and TFA-94059 AC 'Guardrail config and model ID are pinned in prod and match what UAT ran on' (in progress) covers exactly this. OAT-05 Q6 asks whether DRAFT counts as pinned, and the deployed id/version is in Tim's 3.1 record. U6b (photo, voice and OpenAI text bypass the guardrail) is gated on TFA-92568.
